gloss: to collect; to recover; to recall

definitions.gloss: to collect; to gather up; to retrieve
definitions.explanation: To collect items that have been distributed or are scattered, bringing them back together.

definitions.gloss: to recall; to withdraw from the market
definitions.explanation: To recall defective products or withdraw items from circulation.

notes:
A versatile verb used for collecting scattered items, recovering costs or investments, and recalling defective products. The noun form ⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧ is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{資源|しげん}{回収|かいしゅう}→資源回収：26673_shigenkaishuu⟧: resource collection; recycling collection
- ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回収|かいしゅう}する: to recover costs
- ⟦{自主|じしゅ}→自主：13979_jishu⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧: voluntary recall
- ⟦リコール→リコール：29697_rikooru⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧: recall (of products)
- ⟦{回収|かいしゅう}{率|りつ}→回収率：26275_kaishuuritsu⟧: collection rate; recovery rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to collect; to gather — focuses on assembling a collection, often of data or specimens
- ⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to gather; to collect — more general and everyday
- ⟦リコール→リコール：29697_rikooru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recall — specifically for product recalls, borrowed from English
